description: This map displays a Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Protected Area (PA) status product for a selected Natura 2000 (N2K) site, shown alongside a detailed satellite image of a specific feature. The left panel provides a wider geographic overview of a natural landscape, with a dark green background representing extensive vegetation (likely forest) and numerous dark blue/black patches indicating water bodies. Overlaid on this background are many red outlines of varying shapes and sizes, which delineate the boundaries of protected areas, consistent with Natura 2000 or Emerald Network sites. A single small yellow dot is centrally located in the upper portion of the left panel, highlighting a point of interest. The right panel presents a high-resolution satellite image, with a faint "2023" watermark, showing a zoomed-in view of the location marked by the yellow dot. This detailed view depicts a dense, dark green forest canopy. A small, yellow hexagonal outline draws attention to a specific feature within this forest, exemplifying isolated features below the Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) that are identified and addressed during the Area of Interest (AoI) refinement process for CLMS Protected Areas products.
